title: Evaluation depends on referenced values
statement: Let $g$ be a Boolean circuit gate and let $vals,vals'$ be lists of Boolean values. If their defaulted lookups agree at every argument of $g$, using false when an index is out of range, then $g$ evaluates to the same Boolean value on both lists.
hypotheses_covered: $vals$ and $vals'$ are lists of Boolean values
